title: Blocktopia
description: Welcome to Blocktopia! We are known for being a vanilla+ server with plugins, exclusive items, immersive lore, and special events that will make your experience truly unique.
body:
Welcome to **Blocktopia**! We are known for being a **vanilla+ server** with plugins, exclusive items, engaging lore, and special events that will make your experience unique.

Our goal is to create a healthy, peaceful, and fun environment for our community to interact and enjoy themselves to the fullest. Furthermore, we have players of different languages, especially from Spanish-speaking countries, and we offer translations into Portuguese and Spanish on the server.

Blocktopia is available for JAVA and BEDROCK versions, and everyone is welcome to our community!

**What is the Blocktopia server IP?**
For **JAVA players**: jogar.blocktopiamp.com
For **BEDROCK players**: jogar.blocktopiamp.com
PORT: 19132

**How do I find the modpack in the Modrinth app?**
You can search for our modpack as:
**Blocktopia Pack**, look for an image with the letters “BT” in uppercase and in purple.

**What does the Blocktopia server offer? We offer various features, such as:**
- Plasmo Voice
- Missions
- PvP Arena
- Clans
- Custom Biomes
- Themed Events
- Lore and Roleplay (RP)
